title: Honey glue pet
body:
Honey Glue Pet is a client-side Minecraft mod designed for managing "Honey Glue" entities from the Simulated mod.

Key Features:
- Visual Selection: Point your crosshair at a honey glue to highlight it, then select and bind it to your management list with a single click.
- Folder Organization: Create folders to group bound glues, with support for drag-and-drop moving and renaming.
- Follow Mode: Selected glues automatically follow the player; Snake Follow arranges all glues along the player's movement trail.
- Size Adjustment: Hold Ctrl + Scroll Wheel to dynamically resize honey glues.
- Text Placement: Arrange bound glues into letter shapes, with support for multi-slide text carousels.
- Footstep Patterns: Save glue arrangements as patterns, then have glues automatically reform the pattern under your feet as you walk.
- Full Keybind Customization: Select, move, delete, batch bind, gather all — every action can be rebound to your preferred keys.
- Persistent Config: All settings and bindings are saved per-server or per-singleplayer-world and restored on rejoin.

Why Download:
If you use honey glues from the Simulated mod for pasting, this mod provides a convenient management experience that greatly improves control precision and efficiency.

Before You Download:
- This is a client-side only mod — no server installation required.
- Required dependency: Simulated mod (provides the honey glue entity). Without it, this mod will not function.
- Built for Minecraft 1.21.1 + NeoForge.
